AddCardToDirectionalGroup.description_en: Adds cards to a specified group

AddDirectionalAddress.description_en: Adds a destination address to a targeted group
AddDirectionalAddress.description_zh: 定向分组新增目标地址

AddDirectionalCard.description_en: Imports directional cards into a directional group
AddDirectionalCard.description_zh: 给定向分组中导入定向卡

BatchAddDirectionalAddress.description_en: Adds access addresses to a directional group
BatchAddDirectionalAddress.description_zh: 给定向分组添加访问地址

DeleteDirectionalAddress.description_en: Delete a target address from a directional group
DeleteDirectionalAddress.description_zh: 定向分组删除目标地址

ForceActivation.description_en: Forcibly activates a card with the same-tier plan to expand the shared traffic pool
ForceActivation.description_zh: 同档位套餐的卡强制激活，实现共享流量扩池

GetCardFlowInfo.description_en: Queries the traffic information of a card

GetCardLatestFlow.description_en: This API is used to query the real-time cycle usage of an IoT card
GetCardLatestFlow.description_zh: 该接口用于查询物联网卡的实时周期用量

GetCardRealStatus.description_en: Queries the status of an IoT card on the carrier side through intelligent diagnostics
GetCardRealStatus.description_zh: 智能诊断-查询卡在运营商侧状态

GetCardStatusStatistics.description_en: Queries risk alerts on the overview page

GetCredentialPoolStatistics.description_en: Queries the pool information associated with a plan credential
GetCredentialPoolStatistics.description_zh: 查询套餐凭证对应的池信息

GetRealNameStatus.description_en: Queries the personal real-name verification status of an IoT card
GetRealNameStatus.description_zh: 该接口用于查询物联网卡的个人实名状态

ListDirectionalAddress.description_en: Queries the list of access addresses for a directional group
ListDirectionalAddress.description_zh: 查询定向分组的访问地址列表

ListDirectionalDetail.description_en: Queries the directional group and access address list of an IoT card
ListDirectionalDetail.description_zh: 查询物联网卡所在的定向分组及访问地址列表

RebindResumeSingleCard.description_en: Changes the status of a card from "rebind deactivated" to "rebind reactivated"
RebindResumeSingleCard.description_zh: 将状态为“换绑停用”的单卡操作为“换绑复用”

Renew.description_en: Renews plan subscriptions and purchases add-on packages for IoT cards. This operation applies only to single-card plans and same-tier pool plans. For unified-payment pool plans, use the pool expansion and feature fee purchase functions in the console
Renew.description_zh: 卡的套餐续订和叠加包订购，仅适用于单卡套餐和同档位池套餐（统付池套餐请通过控制台进行扩池和购功能费）

ResumeSingleCard.description_en: Resume a single card that is in the "Voluntarily Deactivated" or "Mass Deactivated" status to the "Reuse" state
ResumeSingleCard.description_zh: 将状态为“主动停用”、“大量停用”的单卡操作为“复用”

SendMessage.description_en: Sends an SMS message from the platform

SetCardStopRule.description_en: Sets the data cap suspension rule for a card. Only same-tier pool plans and unified payment pool plans are supported
SetCardStopRule.description_zh: 设置卡的达量停用规则，仅支持同档位池套餐和统付池套餐

StopSingleCard.description_en: Proactively deactivates a single card that is in the "In Use" state
StopSingleCard.description_zh: 将状态为“使用中”的单卡进行自主停用

UpdateAutoRechargeSwitch.description_en: Enables or disables the auto-renewal feature for a card. This operation applies only to single-card plans and same-tier pool plans
UpdateAutoRechargeSwitch.description_zh: 该接口用于开启或关闭卡的自动续费功能，仅适用于单卡套餐和同档位池套餐

VerifyIotCard.description_en: Queries whether an IoT card is a directional card
VerifyIotCard.description_zh: 查询物联网卡是否为定向卡
